content_text: [1/2 @gregoryblotnick] yeah that CPRT pitch is #1 and extra points for the team name choice "what's your guys' team name" "we're Stone Rock Capital, it represents our rock-solid discipline in fundamental equity valuation, and why we think FICO is compelling" "hahaha what a dickless team name. and yeah, FICO is probably compelling as long as you're 'going horse mode.' anyway we're the Sharpe Shooters and we're pressing CPRT down 50%." shit-talk aside, the pitch is better than 99.99% of what you see on twtr each day these are better than top MBA pitches its probably better than the average deck from Starboard Value, JANA, Corvex, prob Pershing Square... there's actual primary research backing the assumptions and not "if CPRT trades to AAP's multiple (they do car stuff too) we see 40% downside" or "VRX is trading at 0.5x our 2160 EPS estimate" you've got entire VC firms in a conference room right now, studying how you modeled taxes and working capital...partners at Sequoia frantically asking grok "can we use CPRT's 2028 tax rate for SPCX" "why are they modeling this junkyard company out to 2029 when we're only modeling space exploration to 2028" all these pitches are all great to the point where anyone who is 40-50 should be like "what the hell" just not supposed to be able to do all this before age 21 so while I want to say "dont forget to have fun in college too," you know what...fuck that, smash the gas pedal let all the other 21 year olds know that you have the #1 seed and that they just have absolutely zero chance, ever, at taking it from you there is always time to have fun not to mention the fact that out of all the types of fun you can have, nothing is more fun than putting your opponents' brains all over the wall. shaking your head as you walk by them, "we tried to tell you, dude...we're the #1 ranked Sharpe Shooters. You didn't want to listen." snatch the trophy and get outta there champion shit 🏆 CPRT Pitch: https://static1.squarespace.com/static/6a74a44d44fa6357ee616596/t/6ae8b7d51c61c47db05405ee/1793636309143/01_SharpeShooters_Short_CPRT.pdf All pitches: https://www.fundamentedge.com/witg-2026 --- [2/2 @gregoryblotnick] 1. title page 2. rev assumptions backed by primary rsch 3 and 4: expense assumptions backed by primary rsch great work
